fields.why: Cumulative rates across 4 adult age groups are compared by rate ratios against 18-49 years, and age-adjusted rates across 4+ race/ethnicity groups are ranked and compared by ratios against Hispanic and White adults.
Age (4 groups) and race/ethnicity (AI/AN, Black, Hispanic, White, possibly A/PI) are the only SPDs compared across 3+ groups; sex is a 2-level descriptor.

The brief's value covers groups assessed by ratios against a reference level, so the mechanical flag ('needs a test') is a false alarm; no test is reported, and only some pairs are contrasted against named referents.
